summary: RFCs 6513, 6514 and others describe how a service provider offers Multicast VPN service to its customers, using point-to-multipoint or multipoint-to-multipoint trees in the backbone. This proposed standard describes the use of ingress replication tunnels as one type of such tree.

eli5.summary: When one person must send the same message to many people, they can make one copy per person themselves. This explains that approach for private networks run by providers.
